# Where these screens come from

Twelve Claude Code screen captures copied unchanged from the Collie project,
https://github.com/AltanS/collie, folder `web/src/fixtures/panes/` (fetched 2026-10-19),
under the MIT licence in `LICENSE` next to this file (copyright 2026 Altan Sarisin).

They are byte-faithful tmux/Herdr captures, colour escape codes included, made by Collie's author
in a sandbox. ollagi uses them only as test input for `src/ollagi/claude_screen.py`, so the state
detector is checked against real Claude screens without spending any tokens.
